authenticate_user_api_key: authenticate a user API key against the LiteLLM proxy server using FastAPI request context
authenticate_websocket_api_key: authenticate a WebSocket connection using Bearer token or api-key header in LiteLLM proxy
build_user_api_key_auth: build a UserAPIKeyAuth object from request headers, JWT claims, and database token lookup
resolve_jwt_to_virtual_key: resolve a JWT token claim to a mapped virtual API key with caching support
extract_api_key_from_headers: extract an API key from multiple header sources including Bearer, Azure, Anthropic, and custom headers
